messages:
maria_cs: Heads up — Kestrel (trial) is still seeing intermittent 429s during SDK init. Started after we gave them the new ephemeral token flow. Logs attached in their ticket but here's a quick snippet.

maria_cs: ```
2026-03-22T14:01:02Z ERROR sdk:init handshake failed status=429 body={"error":"rate_limited"} client_id=kestrel-frontend
```

maria_cs: Behavior: first few requests OK, then bursts of 4-6 in <1s lead to 429s for ~20s window. They use browser JS SDK with parallel preflight on page load.

sam_eng: thanks, can you confirm client UA + pref light concurrency? likely preflight fanout.
sam_eng: what's their preflight code — are they prefetching multiple ephemeral tokens in parallel?

maria_cs: they do 6 preflight calls on mount (old SPA pattern). UA: KestrelWeb/1.3.0.

sam_eng: yep that's a classic thundering-preflight. quick mitigations: 1) splay preflight calls (stagger 100-700ms random) 2) turn on client-side sticky token reuse for 15s 3) exponential backoff on 429 honoring Retry-After header.

sam_eng: also check ephemeral token TTL client vs server — if client requests new token too aggressively it creates renewal storms.

elliot_support: adding a short playbook we can send to the customer. want me to open a small enablement session with them? 15-20m.

maria_cs: yes please. they asked for a live walkthrough. propose today 17:00 PT.

sam_eng: I'll join and bring a simple patch for the client: change parallel preflight from 6 -> sequential with jitter. snippet below: 

sam_eng: ```js
// naive splay
const splay = (i) => Math.floor(Math.random() * 600) + 100 * i;
for (let i=0;i<6;i++) setTimeout(()=>fetchEphemeral(), splay(i));
```

sam_eng: We can also enable a temporary rate-relax on their tenant for today while we run the session. Need @deploybot to confirm any recent infra pushes.

deploybot: deploy pipeline: new token-cache change landed 2026-03-22T13:30Z to runtime. No global config flags toggled. Suggest ops adjust tenant quota if needed. :gear:

elliot_support: I will draft the playbook and include the following steps: 1) reduce parallel preflight, 2) reuse tokens for 15s, 3) add jitter/backoff, 4) monitor 429s in console.

maria_cs: please also include this one-off workaround: set client to reuse last token when creating a new ephemeral within 500ms of a previous request. It helped another customer.

sam_eng: noted. Can we relax tenant rate-limit for kestrel-trial by +50% for 2 hours? If ops agrees we can run the session and watch.

deploybot: ops note: temporary quota bump can be applied by SRE runbook, request ticket #SRE-8857. Approver needed.

maria_cs: I'll open SRE-8857 and ask for expedited approval. booking session 17:00 PT, invite sent.

sam_eng: thanks — during the call I'll show telemetry to confirm reduction in 429s after splay. small follow-up: capture client_id and sample headers for the ticket.

maria_cs: copied. Will attach sample logs and customer consent to share headers.

elliot_support: playbook draft ready, will paste into ticket. :white_check_mark:

maria_cs: great — closing here for now, will report back after the enablement. :thumbsup:
